turns.spongebob: Squidward! SQUIDWARD! Open the door, it's an emergency!
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] Oh, fantastic, screaming before I've even had my tea. [groan] [muttering to himself] I can't open the door right now, my clarinet reeds are soaking and the whole living room smells like varnish.

turns.spongebob: I can hear those reeds soaking from out here — you
turns.squidward: [suddenly shrill] Eavesdropping on my reeds now? [flat, exhausted] Go away, SpongeBob, my portrait oils are drying and your <emphasis>breathing</emphasis> will ruin them.

turns.spongebob: Your clarinet playing is so beautiful the jellyfish stopped just to listen!
turns.squidward: [suspicious, narrowing eyes] ...Beautiful? You really mean that? [pompous, savoring every word] Of course, it takes a true <emphasis>genius</emphasis> to coax such tones from a clarinet, [pause] but I can't demonstrate now, my music room is being dusted.

turns.spongebob: Squidward, the jellyfish swarm is on Conch Street RIGHT NOW and Gary's trapped inside with you!
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] Gary is in [scoff] <emphasis>my</emphasis> house? [suddenly shrill] SpongeBob! I told you, I'm in the middle of a clarinet tuning bath and I can't find my keys!
[muttering to himself] Finally, silence... [flat, exhausted] Don't think this means the door is open, I'm polishing my <slow>precious</slow> clarinet collection.

turns.spongebob: Ahoy Squidward, 'tis I, Mr. Krabs! Open up, lad, ye be late fer yer shift!
turns.squidward: [groan] Oh great, now you're doing voices? [flat, exhausted] Tell Mr. Krabs it's my day off, and I can't open up because my front hallway is flooded with paint water.

turns.spongebob: I brought you a hot Krabby Patty with extra
turns.squidward: [suspicious, sniffing] A hot Krabby Patty... with extra what? [flat, exhausted] Leave it on the step, I'm in the middle of waxing my floors and I can't open the door.

turns.spongebob: Okay, you leave me no choice... I'm gonna sing the Campfire Song Song OUT HERE until you open up!
turns.squidward: [suddenly shrill] No no no no no! [flat, exhausted] Not that infernal song, you'll crack my eye-windows. [muttering to himself] Fine, hum quietly out there, I'm re-gluing my clarinet pads and can't touch the door.

turns.spongebob: If Gary gets stung in there it'll be all my fault for not getting in
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] [long sigh] Fine, if the snail is actually in here... [muttering to himself] Come on then, quickly, before the jellyfish follow you in.
